name: extella-codex-bridge
description: Connect Codex and Extella in both directions through Extella MCP and a signed local account-wide bridge.

interface.shortDescription: Connect every Extella agent to local Codex
interface.longDescription: Adds Extella MCP access in Codex and a signed, loopback-only account bridge that lets every current and future Extella agent call local Codex after explicit setup.
defaultPrompt: Подключи Codex к текущему аккаунту Extella.
Проверь состояние моста Extella → Codex без запуска модели.
Покажи, какие агенты Extella могут вызывать Codex.
